title: Florida Deputies Go Hunting for Predators
description:
Bodycam video shows the moments multiple Florida men were caught in a sting operation. Undercover detectives posing online agreed to meet up with four of them, according to the Flagler County Sheriff’s Office. But when the men arrived at the meet-up location, they were all forced to face the consequences. In total, investigators said the sting, deemed "Operation Heartbreaker 2," led to eight arrests across the state and involved multiple agencies. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
